question: Are existing overhead electric utility poles and conductors shown on the site plan? If so, what is the horizontal distance between the closest proposed building and the existing overhead conductors/poles?
checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
regionHint: western boundary of the site near Valley View Road
